findings.title: PipeKit was assigned to Northwind Logistics — AtliQ may not own it any more (§9.2)
findings.explanation: Potential conflict — not a breach determination. Northwind Logistics §9.2 vested all IP in its Deliverables — expressly including pre-existing tools incorporated — in Northwind Logistics, and SOW-1 incorporated PipeKit into the delivered pipeline. This contract asks AtliQ to warrant it is the sole owner of PipeKit and to license it irrevocably. AtliQ may not be able to give that warranty or licence without Northwind Logistics's consent, and an IP indemnity would sit behind it. In June 2025 the IP clause was 'skimmed'.
findings.contract_quote: Supplier warrants that it is the sole owner of all intellectual property rights in PipeKit, that it is entitled to grant the rights set out in § 6.2, and that PipeKit and its use under this Agreement do not infringe any rights of third parties.

evidence.quote: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone.

findings.title: GDPR DPA (Annex 3) referenced but not attached
findings.explanation: The contract makes the Art. 28 GDPR data processing agreement — including the Standard Contractual Clauses for transfers to India — an integral part (Annex 3), but it is not in the draft. AtliQ would be signing up to DPA terms it has not seen (audit rights, sub-processor approval, breach notice, liability). Ask for Annex 3 before signing.
findings.contract_quote: To the extent Supplier processes personal data on behalf of Client, the Parties shall conclude the Data Processing Agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR attached as Annex 3, which forms an integral part of this Agreement.

findings.title: Attachment referenced but not provided: Annex 1
findings.explanation: The contract incorporates Annex 1, which are not in the document received. Their terms (e.g. specifications, security requirements, policies) would bind AtliQ unseen. This is a potential gap until someone confirms the attachments exist and reviews them.
findings.contract_quote: "Milestone" means a defined stage of the project as set out in Annex 1.

findings.title: Germany law
findings.explanation: AtliQ's default is Indian law for Pvt Ltd and US state law for Inc. Germany is the counterparty's home law, which AtliQ has accepted before when needed (English law for Northwind, DIFC for Al Noor, Singapore/SIAC for CloudSpan). Disputes would be run under unfamiliar law, typically needing local counsel.
